description: Get a Nomads.com member's own trip history (past and upcoming stays: city, country, dates), newest first, 200 by default; use from_date/to_date for a period and limit for more. Authenticated as the member: signed in through the connector (OAuth sign-in or an Authorization header) if set up, otherwise pass the member's username and their personal key from https://nomads.com/settings - this is private data, not for looking up other people.

from_date.description: Only trips that end on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

limit.description: How many trips, newest first: 1 to 1000, default 200

to_date.description: Only trips that start on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: get_trips
